info.name: Quicksol Real Estate API
info.description:
Complete API collection for QuickSol Real Estate Management System.

## Features
- Multi-tenancy with company isolation
- RBAC: 10 security profiles (tenant + property_owner)
- Profile Unification (Feature 010)
- User Onboarding & Password Management (Feature 009)
- Properties, Agents, Leads management
- Commission tracking and performance
- Owner & Company management
- Complete Assignment CRUD

## Authentication Flow
1. **Get OAuth Token**: POST /api/v1/auth/token
2. **User Login**: POST /api/v1/users/login (returns session_id)
3. **Use Both**: Authorization header + X-Openerp-Session-Id header (GET) or session_id in body (POST type=json)
4. **Set tenant context**: `X-Company-ID` header on authenticated multi-tenant endpoints

## Headers
- `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`
- `X-Openerp-Session-Id: {{session_id}}` (REQUIRED for GET)
- `X-Company-ID: {{company_id}}` (REQUIRED for invite/resend-invite)
- `User-Agent: {{user_agent}}`
- `Content-Type: application/json`

## Important Notes (ADR-016)
- ⚠️ **POST/PUT/PATCH**: `session_id` goes in **body JSON** (not header)
- ⚠️ **GET requests**: `session_id` goes in **header** `X-Openerp-Session-Id`
- ⚠️ **No JSON-RPC**: Business endpoints send JSON directly in body
- ✅ **Variables**: Use {{...}} for all authentication values
- ✅ **Test Scripts**: OAuth and Login endpoints auto-save tokens

## ⚠️ Known Limitations
- None currently

item.name: 2. User Invitation
item.description: User invitation endpoints with RBAC authorization matrix.

request.description:
**✅ Feature 010 Unified Profile Flow**

Invite user from existing profile record. All data (name, email, document, phone, birthdate, company_id, profile_type) is automatically loaded from the profile.

**Authentication:** Bearer Token + Session ID required
**Multi-tenancy:** Company context loaded from profile.company_id
**Fingerprint validation:** Active (IP + User-Agent)

**Request Body:**
- `profile_id` (required): ID of thedevkitchen.estate.profile record from POST /api/v1/profiles
- `agent` (optional, object): Only used when the target profile's type is 'agent'; ignored for every other profile_type invited through this same endpoint. Contains ONLY the fields exclusive to the real.estate.agent record that have no equivalent on the already-referenced profile: `creci`, `bank_name`, `bank_account`, `pix_key`. Identity fields (`name`, `cpf`, `email`, `phone`, `mobile`, `hire_date`) are NOT part of this object — they already live on the profile shared by every profile_type, and `company_id`/`user_id` are always server-derived (never accepted here, per ADR-008).
- `session_id` (required): Session ID from login

**Workflow:**
1. POST /api/v1/profiles → Create profile with all user data → Get profile_id
2. POST /api/v1/users/invite with profile_id → Send invitation email

**Feature 026 — Agent Invite Object:**
When the target profile's type is 'agent', the optional nested `agent` object (see Request Body above) is validated and atomically linked to (or, defensively, created for) the underlying real.estate.agent record in the same transaction as the invite. If the agent-link step fails (e.g. CRECI conflict), the entire transaction — including the newly created res.users — is rolled back, so no partial state is left behind.

**Process:**
1. Validates profile_id exists
2. Checks profile has no linked user yet (partner_id must be null)
3. Extracts name, email, document, phone, birthdate, company_id from profile
4. Derives profile_type from profile.profile_type_id.code
5. Creates res.users with invitation flow
6. Links profile to user via partner_id
7. If profile_type is 'agent': links (or, defensively, creates) the real.estate.agent record in the same transaction — every other profile_type (including tenant/property_owner) only ever creates the res.users login, no separate domain record
8. Generates invite token (UUID v4 → SHA-256)
9. Sends invitation email with set-password link

**Authorization Matrix:**
- Owner: Can invite all 10 profiles
- Manager: Can invite 5 operational profiles (agent, prospector, receptionist, financial, legal)
- Agent: Can invite tenant + property_owner
- Others: 403 Forbidden

**10 Profile Types:**
- Admin: owner, director, manager
- Operational: agent, prospector, receptionist, financial, legal
- External: tenant, property_owner

**Errors:**
- 400: Missing profile_id, invalid `agent` object fields, or other validation errors
- 403: Authorization matrix violation
- 404: Profile not found
- 409: Profile already has a linked user account, OR (Feature 026) agent-link upsert conflict (e.g. duplicate CRECI) — transaction rolled back

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": 42,
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "document": "12345678901",
    "profile": "agent",
    "profile_id": 123,
    "signup_pending": true,
    "invite_sent_at": "2026-02-21T10:30:00",
    "invite_expires_at": "2026-02-28T10:30:00",
    "agent_id": 456
  },
  "message": "User invited successfully. Email sent to john@example.com",
  "links": {
    "self": "/api/v1/users/42",
    "resend_invite": "/api/v1/users/42/resend-invite",
    "collection": "/api/v1/users",
    "profile": "/api/v1/profiles/123",
    "agent": "/api/v1/agents/456"
  }
}
```

**Note:** `data.agent_id` and `links.agent` are only present when the target profile's type is 'agent' (Feature 026); they are omitted for all other profile types.

**Authentication:** Bearer Token + Session ID required
**Multi-tenancy:** Scoped by `X-Company-ID`; only same active company is allowed
**Rate Limiting:** Max 5 resends per user (configurable)

**IMPORTANT:** Business endpoints do NOT use JSON-RPC format. Send JSON directly in body.

**Behavior:**
- Invalidates previous pending invite token
- Generates new token with fresh TTL
- Sends new invite email
- Returns 429 if max resends exceeded
- Returns 404 if user not found, invalid company context, or cross-company
- Returns 400 if user already active

**Request Body:**
- `user_id` (required): User ID from invite response (auto-saved by Invite User test script)
- `session_id` (required): Session ID from login

**Required Headers:**
- `X-Company-ID` (required): Active company scope for request

**Workflow:**
1. Execute "Invite User" → user_id auto-saved to {{user_id}}
2. Execute "Resend Invite" → uses {{user_id}} from environment

**Error precedence:** 403 (authz) → 404 (isolation/context) → 400 (validation)

request.description:
**Authentication:** None (public endpoint)
**Token Source:** Invite email

**IMPORTANT:** This is a PUBLIC endpoint. No OAuth token or session required.

**Request Body:**
- `token` (required): Raw invite token from email URL — exactly 32 lowercase hex chars (UUID v4 hex)
- `password` (required): New password (min 8 chars)
- `confirm_password` (required): Must match password

**Token Security (v1.20):**
- **Format validation**: Token must be exactly 32 lowercase hex characters. Any other format → 400 `validation_error` (rejected before DB lookup)
- **Type enforcement**: Only `invite` tokens accepted here. Sending a `reset` token → 404 `not_found` (cross-type reuse blocked, no state leak)
- **State enforcement**: Token must be `pending` (not `used`, `expired`, or `invalidated`)

**Errors:**
- 400: Validation error (password rules or malformed token format)
- 404: Token not found (or wrong token type — cross-type abuse blocked)
- 410: Token expired (`token_expired`) or already used (`token_used`)

**Authentication:** None (public endpoint)
**Anti-Enumeration Pattern (ADR-008):** Always returns 200

**IMPORTANT:** This endpoint ALWAYS returns 200 OK with same response, regardless of whether email exists or not. This prevents user enumeration attacks.

**Request Body:**
- `email` (required): Email address to send reset link

**Behavior (if email exists and user is active):**
1. Invalidates previous pending reset tokens
2. Generates new reset token (type='reset')
3. Sends reset email with token link
4. Rate limiting check (3 requests/hour)

**Behavior (if email doesn't exist or user inactive):**
1. Returns same 200 response
2. No email sent
3. No database changes

**Response 200 (always):**
```json
{
  "message": "If the email exists, a password reset link has been sent."
}
```

**Rate Limiting:**
- 429: If more than 3 requests in 1 hour from same IP

**Security Features:**
- Anti-enumeration (identical response for all cases)
- Rate limiting per IP
- Token expiry (default 24h)
- Previous tokens invalidated

**Authentication:** None (public endpoint)
**Token Source:** Reset password email

**IMPORTANT:** This is a PUBLIC endpoint. No OAuth token or session required.

**Request Body:**
- `token` (required): Raw reset token from email URL — exactly 32 lowercase hex chars (UUID v4 hex)
- `password` (required): New password (min 8 chars)
- `confirm_password` (required): Must match password

**Token Security (v1.20):**
- **Format validation**: Token must be exactly 32 lowercase hex characters. Any other format → 400 `validation_error` (rejected before DB lookup)
- **Type enforcement**: Only `reset` tokens accepted here. Sending an `invite` token → 404 `not_found` (cross-type reuse blocked, no state leak)
- **State enforcement**: Token must be `pending`. Status `used`, `expired`, or `invalidated` → 410
- **Last-token-wins**: When a new reset is requested, all previous pending reset tokens for that user are invalidated before the new one is created

**Password Requirements:**
- Minimum 8 characters
- Must match confirm_password

**Side Effects:**
- Password updated
- Token marked as `used`
- **ALL active sessions invalidated** (`is_active=false` in `thedevkitchen_api_session`)
- User must login again after reset

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Password reset successfully. You can now log in with your new password.",
  "links": [{"href": "/api/v1/users/login", "rel": "login", "type": "POST"}]
}
```

**Errors:**
- 400: Password validation failed or malformed token format
- 404: Token not found (or wrong token type — cross-type abuse blocked)
- 410: Token expired (`token_expired`) or already used (`token_used`)
